metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to get quick and long-lasting toe pain relief.

We're going to focus on several different methods including stretching, strengthening, mobilization, and self-massage.

Each exercise works a little differently. Make sure to go through them all and use what gives you the most relief.

Watch now and instantly relieve toe pain and tightness!
